name: Renters Insurance Live Transfers

hero.headline: Renters Insurance Live Transfers
hero.subheadline: Connect with high-intent consumers actively looking for renters insurance solutions.

overview: Renters Insurance Live Transfers are consumers qualified by our team and warm-transferred to your agents, generated by Altarious Global performance campaigns and delivered to your business in real time. Reach tenants who need renters coverage for a new lease or landlord requirement and connect them with licensed agents who can bind quickly.

Live Transfers keep renters programs efficient at scale. Our team confirms the tenant's state, rental address, move-in timing and whether they own a vehicle before warm-transferring to an agent, so the agent knows immediately whether a bundle opportunity exists. Pre-screening also removes homeowners who searched for the wrong product and consumers outside the licensed footprint. For agencies running multi-line growth strategies, transfers flagged with an auto bundle opportunity can be routed to producers focused on higher-value accounts.

This product is suited to insurance businesses with a team ready to answer during defined hours, a clear view of the consumer they want, and the capacity to convert a live conversation. The acquisition objective is simple: put your team in front of renters insurance consumers at the moment they are deciding.
targetConsumer: Tenants aged 18 to 45 in apartments, condos and single-family rentals, including students, young professionals and families. High-value segments are tenants signing a new lease with a landlord requirement, renters who also own a vehicle and can bundle, and higher-income renters with valuables that exceed basic policy limits.
consumerIntent: Typical intent signals include: searching for renters insurance quotes or cost; signing a new lease with a landlord proof-of-insurance requirement; moving into a new apartment within the next few weeks; shopping auto insurance and looking for a bundle discount.
howGenerated: Consumers are acquired through performance campaigns targeting searches such as "renters insurance quotes" and "cheap renters insurance", plus social and comparison placements. Interested consumers speak with our qualification team before any transfer is attempted.
qualification: Qualification is configured to your appetite. Standard renters insurance criteria include: currently renting or about to sign a lease in a state the buyer writes; age 18 or older and the named tenant on the lease; rental address and move-in date confirmed; approximate personal property value discussed; interest in bundling with auto or other policies noted; ready to purchase or receive a quote today.
delivery: Once qualified, the consumer is bridged directly to your designated number or queue with a warm introduction. Delivery runs only during your operating hours with daily caps, and you can pause or adjust criteria at any time.

faq.q: Can programs prioritise renters who also need auto insurance?
faq.a: Yes. Screening captures vehicle ownership and current auto coverage so that bundle-ready transfers can be identified and routed accordingly.

faq.q: How quickly do renters typically need coverage?
faq.a: Most callers need proof of insurance within days for a lease signing or move-in, so programs work best for agencies that can bind and deliver documents on the same call.

faq.q: Can you target specific metro areas or ZIP codes?
faq.a: Targeting can be set at the state, metro or ZIP level to align with your licensing and the rental markets you want to grow in.
